slides.title: Which parts of Ethiopia does the US say to avoid?
Do not travel to three regions
slides.body: US Embassy: Amhara (including Lalibela), Tigray and Afar. Leave if it is safe.

slides.title: Flights to Axum and Shire suspended
slides.body: The Embassy says the situation in Central Tigray and near the Eritrea border may change at any time.

slides.title: Check several reliable sources
slides.body: The Embassy warns some social media accounts post false or misleading reports.

slides.title: Safety and access for civilians
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
